title: Lesson 11: Idempotency & Safe Retries — js-tools
desc: Exactly-once is an illusion — the Two Generals problem means a timeout cannot be told apart from three different outcomes; an idempotency key identifies the intent, not the attempt; the dedup write and the business logic must share one transaction, because no ordering is safe once you split them; measured, 78,774 concurrent requests on one key produce exactly 1 row and exactly 1 status 201, while switching it off produces 14,236 rows and a balance of −423,600.
